title: OAuth & OpenID Connect
definition: OAuth 2.0 is an authorization framework allowing third-party apps to obtain limited access to an HTTP service. OpenID Connect is an authentication layer built on top of OAuth 2.0.
simpleExplanation: 'Log in with Google'. You don't give the website your Google password. You give them a temporary VIP pass that only lets them read your email address.

answers.question: What is the main tradeoff of OAuth?
answers.answer: Usually a tradeoff between Server CPU usage, TTFB (Time to First Byte), and Client CPU usage.
